CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH cat AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id, MAX(department_name) AS department_name,
           MAX(subject_title) AS subject_title
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    GROUP BY term_code, subject_id
),
summary AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id, MAX(cluster_type) AS cluster_type,
           MAX(subject_enrollment_number) AS total_enrollment
    FROM courses_subject_offered_summary
    GROUP BY term_code, subject_id
),
level_infer AS (
    -- infer course level from subject_id number before first dot or digits after dot
    SELECT s.term_code, s.subject_id,
           CASE
             WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(s.subject_id, '^(\d+)', 1) IS NOT NULL THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(s.subject_id, '^(\d+)', 1)
             ELSE NULL
           END AS course_level
    FROM courses_subject_offered s
    GROUP BY s.term_code, s.subject_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT s.term_code, s.subject_id,
           c.department_name, c.subject_title,
           s.cluster_type,
           l.course_level,
           s.total_enrollment
    FROM summary s
    LEFT JOIN cat c USING(term_code, subject_id)
    LEFT JOIN level_infer l USING(term_code, subject_id)
    WHERE (LOWER(department_name) LIKE '%biology%' OR LOWER(offer_dept_name) LIKE '%biology%' OR subject_id LIKE '7.%')
),
-- TIP metrics per subject
tip AS (
    SELECT d.term_code, d.subject_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.tip_material_key) AS tip_unique_materials,
           AVG(m.new_shelf_price) FILTER (WHERE m.new_shelf_price IS NOT NULL AND m.new_shelf_price > 0) AS avg_new_price,
           AVG(m.used_shelf_price) FILTER (WHERE m.used_shelf_price IS NOT NULL AND m.used_shelf_price > 0) AS avg_used_price,
           SUM(d.record_count) AS tip_total_records
    FROM tip_detail d
    LEFT JOIN tip_material m USING(tip_material_key)
    GROUP BY d.term_code, d.subject_id
),
-- Library metrics per subject
lib AS (
    SELECT r.term_code, r.subject_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.catalog_title) AS library_unique_titles,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.catalog_isbn) AS library_unique_isbns
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail r
    LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog c USING(library_reserve_catalog_key)
    GROUP BY r.term_code, r.subject_id
)
SELECT
  b.department_name AS department_name,
  b.subject_title AS course_title,
  b.cluster_type AS cluster_type,
  b.total_enrollment AS total_enrollments,
  AVG(b.total_enrollment) OVER (PARTITION BY b.cluster_type) AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster,
  b.course_level AS course_level,
  COALESCE(t.tip_unique_materials, 0) AS num_unique_course_materials,
  t.avg_new_price AS avg_new_price_tip,
  t.avg_used_price AS avg_used_price_tip,
  COALESCE(t.tip_total_records, 0) AS tip_total_record_count,
  COALESCE(l.library_unique_titles, 0) AS num_unique_library_titles,
  COALESCE(l.library_unique_isbns, 0) AS num_unique_library_isbns
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN tip t USING(term_code, subject_id)
LEFT JOIN lib l USING(term_code, subject_id)
-- Grouping output by cluster type and course level as requested, but present per-course rows with group metrics
ORDER BY b.cluster_type NULLS LAST, b.course_level NULLS LAST, b.subject_title
LIMIT 200

# Aggregate biology courses by cluster type and course level
import pandas as pd

group_sql = '''
WITH cat AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id,
           MAX(department_name) AS department_name,
           MAX(subject_title) AS subject_title
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    GROUP BY term_code, subject_id
),
summary AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id,
           MAX(cluster_type) AS cluster_type,
           MAX(subject_enrollment_number) AS total_enrollment,
           MAX(offer_dept_name) AS offer_dept_name
    FROM courses_subject_offered_summary
    GROUP BY term_code, subject_id
),
level_infer AS (
    SELECT s.term_code, s.subject_id,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(s.subject_id, '^(\\d+)', 1) AS course_level
    FROM courses_subject_offered s
    GROUP BY s.term_code, s.subject_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT s.term_code, s.subject_id,
           COALESCE(c.department_name, s.offer_dept_name) AS department_name,
           c.subject_title,
           s.cluster_type,
           l.course_level,
           s.total_enrollment
    FROM summary s
    LEFT JOIN cat c USING(term_code, subject_id)
    LEFT JOIN level_infer l USING(term_code, subject_id)
    WHERE (
      LOWER(COALESCE(c.department_name, s.offer_dept_name)) LIKE '%biology%'
      OR s.subject_id LIKE '7.%'
    )
),
-- TIP metrics per subject
tip AS (
    SELECT d.term_code, d.subject_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.tip_material_key) AS tip_unique_materials,
           AVG(CASE WHEN m.new_shelf_price IS NOT NULL AND m.new_shelf_price > 0 THEN m.new_shelf_price END) AS avg_new_price,
           AVG(CASE WHEN m.used_shelf_price IS NOT NULL AND m.used_shelf_price > 0 THEN m.used_shelf_price END) AS avg_used_price,
           SUM(d.record_count) AS tip_total_records
    FROM tip_detail d
    LEFT JOIN tip_material m USING(tip_material_key)

-- Library metrics per subject
lib AS (
    SELECT r.term_code, r.subject_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.catalog_title) AS library_unique_titles,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.catalog_isbn) AS library_unique_isbns
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail r

joined AS (
    SELECT b.term_code, b.subject_id, b.department_name, b.subject_title,
           b.cluster_type, b.course_level, b.total_enrollment,
           COALESCE(t.tip_unique_materials, 0) AS tip_unique_materials,

           COALESCE(l.library_unique_titles, 0) AS library_unique_titles,

    FROM base b

    LEFT JOIN lib l USING(term_code, subject_id)

SELECT
  cluster_type,
  course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_courses,
  SUM(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollments,
  AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster_level,
  SUM(tip_unique_materials) AS total_unique_course_materials,
  AVG(avg_new_price) AS avg_new_price_tip,
